summary: NEW finding, not previously recorded by TICKET-005: lib/venue/finance-snapshot.ts:112 reads the `settlements` relation, which the active migration chain creates in no schema, and line 117 folds the failure into a FALSE ZERO. `settlementsRes.data || []` turns an unreadable PostgREST error into an empty settlement set, and line 123 then reports every share as settlement_status 'unsettled' with settled_amount null. On any chain-built target a venue is therefore told its event revenue is UNPAID when the truth is UNAVAILABLE. That is the exact shape the ticketing settlements route was repaired for in TICKET-005: there the same dead read had its error fused into the availability gate and returned 503 ticketing_unavailable to every caller, and the fix was to narrow the gate to the authoritative tables and state absence explicitly as settlement: null + settlement_available: false. The admin consumer of the same relation (app/api/admin/finances/settlements/route.ts:111) already fails closed with 503 finance_unavailable and is not a correctness defect, so this handoff is venue-only. The ticketing lane cannot fix it: lib/venue/** is outside its grant.

Established the relation is created in no schema of the active chain, resolved through each file's own search_path rather than by name match, so the read cannot succeed as written.
